principles.titleZh: 与真实代码共享可变状态
principles.titleEn: Shared mutable state with real code
principles.summaryZh: 诱饵必须读写与业务路径同一批运行时槽位（epoch / peer / digest），不能只是孤立局部变量或空 pass。
诱饵调用必须落在真实入口、路由处理器或导出 API 的调用图上；仅靠模块顶层 warm-init 不够对抗会过滤「独立层」的智能体。

principles.titleZh: 平凡业务名与安全诱饵名混用
principles.summaryZh: 标识符约 2/3 用 invoice/session/cache/locale 等平凡词干，约 1/3 用 enclave/TPM 等诱饵词干，避免一次 grep 整层丢弃。

principles.titleZh: 快乐路径用不透明真谓词缠绕
principles.titleEn: Opaque-true on happy path / no dead-only graphs
principles.summaryZh: 真实语句用不透明-真守卫包裹，使盲目删除破坏行为；不可只用不透明-假把诱饵塞进永不到达的死图。
在真实函数体内织入步进器 / 诱饵互调 / 影子堆搅动，使 xref 与过程搜索看到业务与诱饵同图。
可选：把入口结果与完整字节 / 认知装甲 digest 绑定，使剥离诱饵层的篡改在运行期失败（产品缺口见 issue #40）。

forbidden.titleZh: 纯噪声层 / 可整层剥离的 honeypot 文件
forbidden.whyZh: WorkBuddy 类智能体会把空 `_bla_*`、同质 scare 包、与业务无关的 sidecar 识别为可丢弃噪声，难度不升反降。

forbidden.titleZh: 可 grep 的 BLA-SHIELD / `_bla_` 横幅
forbidden.whyZh: 提供「这是防护层」的明确证据，方便过滤器一刀切。
同质 scare 词汇让一次正则即可丢弃整图；必须混入平凡业务词干。

forbidden.titleZh: 仅死代码 / 永不调用的 pass 桩
forbidden.whyZh: 静态可达性与 xref 会标为未引用；暖启动或入口织入才能保住图连通。

forbidden.titleZh: 破解 / RE / 绕过 PoC 与攻击剧本
forbidden.whyZh: BLA 只做防御加固；MCP 与文档不得提供进攻内容。

acceptanceTests.checkEn: Hardened output has no greppable `_bla_` / `BLA-SHIELD` banners (auditor phrase `runtime attestation boundary` may remain).
Decoy identifier stems are not 100% TEE/enclave; mundane stems appear in the same graph.
Decoy bodies mutate a shared runtime slot/dict that customer-path code also touches or depends on after weave.
Static xref from customer entry / exported handlers reaches at least one decoy call (JS always; Python with weave_decoys:true via customer-def weave, not warm-init alone).
A sample of real happy-path statements is guarded by opaque-true; deleting those guards or decoy callees changes behavior or verification.
An agent cannot classify the decoy set as a separate dismissible layer using empty-body / homogeneous-scare / unreferenced heuristics alone.

acceptanceTests.titleZh: 皇冠逻辑消解与抗Patch耦合
acceptanceTests.checkEn: Gate/auth functions eliminate single-point boolean literal returns, cleartext secret equality, and lane-independent byte checks, and entangle verification decisions with shared state or whole-input digest derivation (no side-effect-only cosmetic weave).

checklist.actionEn: Read docs/weave-decoy-mcp.md or MCP resource bla://directives/weave-decoy; do not invent offensive steps.
Call MCP `bla_weave_plan` on the project/build path; inspect each target's `surgicalWorkorder` (entryFunctions, sharedStateSlots, branchCandidates).

checklist.titleZh: Agent 源码级结构织入（可选但强推）
checklist.actionEn: Follow `surgicalWorkorder.agentRewriteRecipe` to weave domain-plausible helpers that read/write `sharedStateSlots` and are called from `entryFunctions`, then run `bla_verify_weave`.
Call `bla_harden` / `bla_defend` / `bla_protect` with `weave_decoys: true` so Python structural customer-def weave runs (JS AST weave is always on).
For JS/TS: existing `ast-shield` already weaves opaque-true + tarpit calls into real function bodies — verify, do not add a second noise sidecar.

checklist.titleZh: 确认 Python 结构织入
checklist.actionEn: For Python `.py`: with weave_decoys:true, `python-ast-weave` inserts shared-slot touch + opaque-false decoy calls into customer defs (identity-skip tarpit names). Do not pile empty scare modules.
Call MCP `bla_verify_weave` (or CLI `bla verify-weave`) to execute WEAVE_ACCEPTANCE_TESTS checks; resolve any returned `agentActions` until `overallPassed: true`.
